hypotheses.name: Domain-specific requirement (not a domain trend)
hypotheses.description: Constraints are a requirement of scientific reproducibility, not a trend across 'regulated or scientific domains'. Any system dealing with scientific evidence needs traceability. This is a domain requirement, not an architectural evolution.

hypotheses.name: Selection bias (observer's own system)
hypotheses.description: The observation is based on 3 systems, one of which (CoResearcher) is the observer's own system. This is selection bias: the observer sees constraint architectures because they built one. There may be no broader trend.
hypotheses.evidence: OBSERVED — 2/3 cited systems are directly related to the observer (CoResearcher is the observer's own system, COrigami was mapped to CoResearcher in SPRINT 70). Only 1/3 (ClawBio) is potentially independent.
hypotheses.strength: MODERATE — weakened. ClawBio is independent of the observer, reducing selection bias. But N=1 independent system is still small.

The 'from' state (model-centric) and the 'moving' claim are not. The observation-candidate remains CANDIDATE, not established.
